drhp.business: GEE Limited manufactures and deals in all kinds of welding consumables and allied equipment and appliances, with no change in the nature of its business during the year. The Company's operations are considered under a single reportable business segment in accordance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards, serving customers across infrastructure, construction, power, oil & gas, shipbuilding, railways, heavy engineering and manufacturing sectors.

drhp.expansion: During the year, members approved a preferential issue of Equity Convertible Warrants, with the proceeds proposed to be utilized towards funding the Company's business expansion plans, capital expenditure, working capital requirements and other general corporate purposes. The Company also raised funds during the year through issuance of secured, redeemable, non-convertible debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis. No specific named capex project, plant, or capacity-addition timeline is disclosed in this bundle.
